name: HaloDomeHouse_01
note: HouseB (26 x 18 x 28, low). Round drum body R 8.2 (about 18 studs wide, one 11-stud storey), single arched door with a big gold arch frame, blue/white awning, arched windows either side of the door and round the flanks, flat roof with a marble balustrade and three roof planters; flower planter front-right. Missing: rooftop cupola (see generator_gaps.md), roof-edge ivy, planter climbing flowers. Built from the review board art/review/img3/HaloDomeHouse_01_check.jpg (2D panel) because the 2D PNGs are not in the worktree; side view not seen.
